gaps.why_now: The existing Phase 9 build step is the narrowest honest place to widen runtime pilot coverage from atomic64 into bitmap without inventing a broader runtime substrate, and it now runs the direct `phase9-runtime-bitmap-sample-tests` plus `phase9-runtime-bitmap-loader-tests` legs so the bounded sample and loader contracts stay first-class beside the survey, module, diff, and shared-loader checks.

A bitmap-specific survey gate keeps the lib/test_bitmap.c anchor, the landed sample, module, diff, and shared loader-request surfaces, plus the remaining shared runtime-control blocker, explicit while the pilot surface stays small.
A sample-backed lifecycle starter is the first honest runtime-facing bitmap step that can reuse the existing bitmap-view helper without pretending the full module substrate already exists.
A dedicated Phase 9 test file keeps the starter sample reviewable and bounded around lifecycle transitions, range mutation, copy, and summary behavior.
A narrow differential gate now captures a few lib/test_bitmap.c expectations for first-set, first-zero, weight, range mutation, and copy behavior before any broader runtime substrate work.

A tiny sample-side loader scaffold makes the existing requires_runtime_substrate contract reviewable through explicit entry and exit symbol names, handoff-stage checks, a no-substrate release path, and a bitmap summary payload that now feeds the shared runtime-loader request surface.

The shared runtime-loader request surface now consumes the bitmap loader handoff directly through `zigux/kernel/runtime_loader.zig`, keeping allocator posture, staged entry and exit symbols, and bitmap payload facts machine-checkable before any real runtime execution path exists.

The bitmap pilot still depends on the broader shared runtime-loader control surface tracked by the runtime loader gap survey: command-name, argv-policy, and environment-derived activation handling are still absent, so the pilot remains pre-execution.

non_goals: a loadable Zigux runtime bitmap module
true runtime execution or lifecycle parity through a shared loader path
the full lib/test_bitmap.c surface beyond the bounded starter and diff cases
shared runtime-loader command-name, argv-policy, or environment activation controls
